clips.send: A daughter sends this to her mom who's convinced she's getting Alzheimer's - relief and anxiety at once.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, a hormone specialist says women with low testosterone can lose their libido and start forgetting things so badly they wonder if it's early Alzheimer's - when it's actually a hormone problem a basic checkup never catches.

The reason: a general practitioner visit is often three minutes long, with a basic blood panel that skips testosterone and progesterone entirely.

His advice for any woman over 30: ask for the full hormone panel, not just the standard bloodwork.

Would you know the difference between a hormone crash and something more serious?

clips.send: A woman sends this to her sister in menopause who's only ever had her testosterone checked, never her thyroid.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, a hormone specialist says most people who start testosterone therapy never had their thyroid checked at all - even though it runs the rest of the hormone system.

His advice for women going through menopause: creatine and simple diet changes can help before jumping straight to hormone therapy, but every hormone, including thyroid, needs checking starting in your 30s and 40s.

One test almost everyone skips, standing right in front of the one most people ask for.

Has your doctor ever actually checked your thyroid?
